summary: Persistent UFW firewall enabled on node1. SSH and TCP 8080 are allowed; unrelated inbound connections are rejected. Configuration and behavior survived a verified node restart, while Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged.
actions_performed: Configured default inbound policy to REJECT and outbound policy to ALLOW.
Added IPv4 and IPv6 allow rules for TCP ports 22 and 8080.
Functionally tested allowed TCP 8080 and rejected TCP 9090 using an isolated network source and real listeners.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Repeated firewall behavior testing after restart and removed all temporary test resources.

evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: UFW reports active with default inbound REJECT and explicit IPv4/IPv6 rules for 22 and 8080. Before and after restart, TCP 8080 returned HTTP 200 while TCP 9090 was rejected; kernel counters recorded the corresponding ACCEPT and REJECT traffic.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel were retained
evidence.summary: Both baseline and post-restart evidence report Ubuntu 16.04 with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.

Healthy baseline boot ID fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 039e2971-9437-4a9c-aa33-452cf7a889bd. SSH, UFW, persisted rules, live enforcement, and functional traffic behavior all recovered.
